orders.approach: Rebuild the ear fan front as one authored lock system in field space: a smooth plan morph, swept tapered pointed coat and tuft locks, a cup clipped clean of coat, and a pale tuft material.
orders.changes: Head only (body-0310 unchanged). The R03 ear fan front is rebuilt in field space as head-0333. A smooth plan morph removes the rolled lip and cuts the old front thorns and cones, then fills the cup pit. Each wing gets the spec's coat locks (P, F, M) and 5 tuft locks, plus filler locks and 2 fluff locks between tuft neighbours. All are swept as tapered half-ellipse tubes on curved axes. Coat material is cut away inside the cup polygon, so the cup has a clean rim, a pointed upper tip and a visible floor. The tuft carries a pale material, which survives the assembly remesh. Locks that start on the crown (P1, F1, M1) are skipped. Crests are kept behind the sheet profile top line. Outer tips are trimmed .009 so the front ear span stays near the sheet. Measured criteria after: R03.1 1.01 (was 1.002), R03.2 .0303 (was .043), R04.1 .930, R04.2 .0521, R04.6 1.059, I09 1.8607; all pass. The technical check passes (1 component, 0 non-manifold edges). Pale tuft covers .82 (L) and .77 (R) of the spec cup polygon in front view, and shows in profile at .0037 and .0036. Tuft render median is about 1.23 times the fan coat, short of the spec's 1.3. Known flaws: a band of smooth roof plate shows above the top locks at the outer top corners. The front and back head-band extra rose (front .049 to .054, back .049 to .062). Two assemblies were made, not one: assembled-0332 failed R03.1 at 1.032 and was abandoned. Details are in build.json in the packet folder. Code is committed as 404c0e22.
